title: File Management & Caching
summary: This module provides utilities for managing files, including caching, cleanup, and resolution for various file sources and providers. It handles normalizing file inputs, configuring file handling strategies, and logging file operations.

nodes.label: Normalize File Source Input
nodes.title: Normalize File Source Input
nodes.description: Converts various raw inputs (strings, paths, bytes, streams) into standardized FileSource objects for internal use.

nodes.label: Coerce File Source Type
nodes.title: Coerce File Source Type
nodes.description: Pydantic-compatible utility to coerce diverse inputs into a FileSource type, ensuring consistent file representation.

nodes.label: Normalize Input File List
nodes.title: Normalize Input File List
nodes.description: Transforms a list of mixed file inputs (paths, URLs, raw data) into a dictionary of named FileInput objects, ready for processing.

nodes.label: Configure File Resolver
nodes.title: Configure File Resolver
nodes.description: Initializes a FileResolver instance, setting policies for file handling like preferring upload over inline and defining upload size thresholds.

nodes.label: Get Supported Content Types
nodes.title: Get Supported Content Types
nodes.description: Retrieves a list of MIME type prefixes (e.g., 'image/', 'application/pdf') that a specific file provider supports for processing.

nodes.label: Cleanup Expired Files (Sync)
nodes.title: Cleanup Expired Files (Sync)
nodes.description: Synchronously identifies and removes expired file entries from the local cache, with an option to delete them from the external provider.

nodes.label: Cleanup Provider Files (Sync)
nodes.title: Cleanup Provider Files (Sync)
nodes.description: Synchronously deletes files associated with a given provider, either from the cache or all files directly from the provider's storage.

nodes.label: Trigger Exit Cleanup
nodes.title: Trigger Exit Cleanup
nodes.description: Registers a function to automatically clean up uploaded files from the cache when the application process terminates.

nodes.label: Cleanup Uploaded Files (Async)
nodes.title: Cleanup Uploaded Files (Async)
nodes.description: Asynchronously removes all uploaded files from the cache and optionally from external providers, supporting concurrent deletions.

nodes.label: Cleanup Expired Files (Async)
nodes.title: Cleanup Expired Files (Async)
nodes.description: Asynchronously identifies and removes expired file entries from the local cache, with an option to delete them from the external provider using concurrency.

nodes.label: Log File Operation Metrics
nodes.title: Log File Operation Metrics
nodes.description: Records detailed metrics for file operations, including type, filename, provider, size, duration, success status, and any errors.

nodes.label: OpenAI Uploader Options
nodes.title: OpenAI Uploader Options
nodes.description: Defines configuration options specific to the OpenAI file uploader, such as chunk size for uploads.

nodes.label: Upload Cache
nodes.title: Upload Cache
nodes.description: Stores metadata about uploaded files, including their IDs, providers, and expiration times, facilitating efficient management and cleanup.

nodes.label: File Uploader Service
nodes.title: File Uploader Service
nodes.description: An interface or service responsible for interacting with external file storage providers to upload, delete, or list files.

nodes.label: File Source Object
nodes.title: File Source Object
nodes.description: A standardized representation of a file, encapsulating its origin (path, bytes, stream, URL) and metadata.

nodes.label: File Input Wrapper
nodes.title: File Input Wrapper
nodes.description: A structured object that wraps a FileSource and potentially other file-related metadata for consistent handling.

nodes.label: File Resolution Logic
nodes.title: File Resolution Logic
nodes.description: The core logic that decides whether a file should be uploaded to an external service or handled inline, based on configured policies.

nodes.label: Provider Constraints
nodes.title: Provider Constraints
nodes.description: Configuration data specifying limitations and capabilities of different file storage providers, such as supported file types or upload size limits.

nodes.label: External File Storage
nodes.title: External File Storage
nodes.description: Cloud storage services or remote file systems where files are stored and managed by file uploaders.

nodes.label: Metrics & Logging System
nodes.title: Metrics & Logging System
nodes.description: A system that collects, stores, and analyzes operational metrics and logs generated by the file management module.

groups.label: File Input Handling
groups.title: File Input Handling
groups.description: Components responsible for processing raw file inputs and converting them into standardized internal representations.

groups.label: File Resolution & Configuration
groups.title: File Resolution & Configuration
groups.description: Manages how files are resolved, uploaded, or inlined based on configuration and provider-specific constraints.

groups.label: Synchronous Cache & File Cleanup
groups.title: Synchronous Cache & File Cleanup
groups.description: Functions for synchronously cleaning up cached files and files associated with specific providers.

groups.label: Asynchronous Cache & File Cleanup
groups.title: Asynchronous Cache & File Cleanup
groups.description: Asynchronous functions for cleaning up cached files and provider files, often with concurrency control for performance.

groups.label: Operational Monitoring
groups.title: Operational Monitoring
groups.description: Component dedicated to logging file operation events for monitoring, debugging, and performance analysis.
